name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9: China (PLA) on the full 0.7.0-dev.58 game. 0.9.0-dev.36 (17 Nov): PvE maps vs China with an AI commander that buys its own units (1P Dead Center, 2P Highway, 3P Dam; PvE lobby tab), game logs and anti-cheat match snapshots uploaded to freedomarrow.app, stress recovery 75 s, ZTQ-15 and VT-5 on the Kurganets stand-in (all weapons fire), CM-501GA a full LMUR clone, explosion effects by weapon and calibre, PLL-09 a 122 mm howitzer, PCL-181 Brutus reload, ZTZ-59/ZTZ-80/WZ1224 changes, ZTZ-85-II and PTZ-89 off the decks, Burke missile alarm, nuclear announcement fade, lobby lists only the mod's maps, altitude arrow fixes. Includes 0.9.0-dev.35. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.44.
